mode: Window-free egui, CPU icon rasterization and lint checks only. No desktop, native-window or screenshot-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Classic v11 cursor/selection/canvas metrics and zoom geometry in light/dark themes. Zoom remains at the right edge, aligns with metrics on wide windows and uses a second row on narrow windows. Fields/actions stay on screen and settle without moving when coordinates or selection change. Pointer coordinates are current in the same rendered frame; natural and forced repeated layout passes are covered. Real selection dimensions and document/history-preserving zoom pass.

icon_unit.scope: All 89 registered icons parse and rasterize with transparency at 24/64/128 pixels; cache and density selection pass. Original Pointer SVG has null sheet coordinates; generated bytes are reproducible.

limits: The host reserves status space before canvas layout and renders Classic v11 status contents afterward, retaining current-frame coordinates without an extra repaint request. Existing messages and recovery-checkpoint details remain available; shared zoom actions retain their semantics. Classic v7/v10 and Studio retain their existing status presentation. This is UI evidence, not native/rendered visual or latency qualification.
